regime: Risk-off with bonds rallying: volatility spike and tech-led drop as metals keep sliding
takeaway: Gold slipped about 1.5% overnight to near $3,570 and silver about 1.6% to near $42.28, leaving gold down about 13% in a month, so the site's gold-downtrend and silver-under-stress checks still match, and miners are lower before the open. The VIX topped 30 for the first time since March and Nasdaq futures fell about 1.5%, matching the volatility-spike and tech-led selloff patterns. Unlike Thursday, Treasury yields dropped 7–8 bp with the 10-year back under 5% and the yen firmed, which looks like the bonds-rallying pattern rather than selling across the board.
